# autoglue_cluster_metadata (Resource)

Manages a cluster metadata key-value pair. Keys are automatically lowercased; values preserve case sensitivity.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID this metadata is attached to.
- `key` (String) Metadata key (automatically lowercased).
- `value` (String) Metadata value (case preserved).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique metadata entry ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
